task.title: Displaying reachable stations on Security Dashboard
task.shortdesc: A multi-tier Security Dashboard allows you to access data from stations in the Network that are not directly connected to the supervisor but can be reached indirectly by stations in its Network. If enabled, you can view any station reachable from the supervisor. For example, if supervisor 1 is connected to supervisor 2, which itself is connected to a station 3, the dashboard will display all three stations, even if supervisor 1 is not directly connected to station 3.

keywords.indexterm: Displaying reachable stations on Security Dashboard

li.p: All stations along the route must be upgraded to and later except for the end station, which can be and later. For stations along the route that are not upgraded to and later, their route will be ignored.
All stations must have an enabled Security Service.
The Network client connection credentials must have access to the Security Service on the end station.

context.p: This feature is useful in a multi-tier environment with multiple supervisors connected to a single, main supervisor.

step.cmd: To enable the multi-tier system security dashboard, expand ConfigServiceSecurity Service and from the View Selector menu in the upper right corner, select the property sheet.
From the Station Link Config drop-down menu, select Display remote station dashboard (directly connected and reachable stations).
step.stepresult:
As a result, for all stations the link on the System Security Dashboard will lead you to the remote station’s Security Dashboard.
If you select Display local view of remote station dashboard, for all stations the link on the System Security Dashboard will lead you to the Security Dashboard Extension on the station on the supervisor. For environments in which the stations in the Network can be reached by the client, but the reachable stations cannot, you can select Display remote station dashboard (directly connected and reachable stations). This will cause the link on the Security Dashboard to lead you to the remote station for directly connected stations, and will lead to the Security Dashboard Device Extension for reachable stations.

step.cmd: Set the Include Reachable Stations On System Dashboard to true.
step.stepresult: The next time you view the Security Dashboard, the reachable stations will automatically be included.
